title: Millions of Co-purchases and Reviews Reveal the Spread of Polarization and Lifestyle Politics across Online Markets

bias_targets.methodology: Using a semi-supervised Relational Graph Convolutional Network (RGCN) on a heterogeneous network of Amazon co-purchases and reviews to propagate liberal and conservative labels, identifying stereotypical partisan alignments in non-political products (lifestyle politics), and applying Bayesian measures to calculate political relevance, alignment, and polarization across product categories.
